summary: Refuse default-branch delivery from an ungoverned checkout of a governed clone

delivery.outcome: Goal refuses legacy default-branch delivery and does not rewrite goal.yaml in a checkout whose clone carries governance in a registered worktree or primary worktree leases; publish through independent protected review.
nonGoals: No change to governed pull-request delivery or to repositories without governance.
No reversal of the already pushed monag commit.

architecture.decision: Derive governed-clone evidence from git worktree registrations and primary leases; refuse the legacy delivery branch before commit and load configuration read-only for -a.
interfaceChanges: goal -a in an ungoverned checkout of a governed clone exits with GOV-DELIVERY-CLONE-001 instead of pushing the default branch.
architecture.rollback: Revert this commit through the protected publication process.

validation.evidence: End-to-end fixture: non-zero exit, unchanged goal.yaml bytes and unchanged remote default branch.
Lease evidence and the legacy flow for clones without governance.
